intent: !(has(aOptionalString) && aOptionalString == "set"): the usual guard under a negation.

plannerDivergence.issue: a has() guard is dropped from the plan even under a negation
plannerDivergence.reason: The planner drops has(aOptionalString) because the comparison reads the same attribute, so the plan is not(eq(aOptionalString, "set")). That is sound only in positive position: check() short-circuits to false where aOptionalString is absent and allows a2, a4, a8, c2 and e1, while the plan leaves the comparison unknown there and denies them. Found by fuzzing (fuzz/s43/0109, as a DENY).

trap: a2, a4, a8, c2 and e1 lack aOptionalString, where the guard makes the conjunction false and check() allows them. The planner drops the guard, so the plan reads the missing attribute and denies them.
